Animated east from the south rotation (= the base) passed as the start frame, because the east rotation turned the crack and core to the edge (David, 2026-10-16). walk is take 2, which tips the shell backwards and over (frames 2-4 are a roll); no frame of either take tilts forward or stands level, so walk alternates frame 1 (15 degrees back) with frame 0 (the base, level). hit repeats idle's first pick. Picks avoid frames with pixels nearest the reserved spark-glow (the core's brightest yellow), which a build refuses and only ART may recolour: idle 1 (so idle starts at 2, the highest clean frame) and death 1-3 (the crack and the core's ring flare), so death keeps 3 frames, 4-6. spawn, telegraph, chipped_outer, chipped_inner and drop are ART's to draw.
